To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the maximum solar to battery energy efficiency is 70.2% at 300 V and 70.5% at 350 V for charging a high voltage NiMH battery using a high voltage PV array.

a direct solar PV charging system can be developed for NiMH batteries that is capable of achieving high charging efficiencies, and that the efficiency of direct solar PV charging can be optimized by varying the photovoltaic array operating voltage to match the battery charging voltage.

a direct solar photovoltaic system can be used to charge a NiMH battery at a high charging voltage and efficiency, and that the solar system output power can be varied to optimize the solar energy to charging efficiency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of solar energy systems for charging batteries for electric vehicle power trains.
the development of a direct, efficient, and renewable method of charging batteries for battery electric vehicles.
the development of solar photovoltaic energy systems for the charging of battery electric vehicles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we developed a solar powered charging system for the high voltage NiMH battery that is used to power a GM 2 mode electric vehicle.
the solar array is a very efficient means for charging batteries, and that the solar array output voltage is a key variable in optimizing the charging efficiency.
the results obtained from the present study indicate that the use of a high voltage solar photovoltaic array is an effective method of charging a high voltage nickel-metal-hydride battery.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown the concept of direct solar photovoltaic battery charging to be viable and that the system developed is capable of charging a battery at a rate of approximately 0.6C at a high voltage.
the solar energy to NiMH battery charging efficiency can be increased by 20 to 40 by using the high voltage solar system developed in this work.
we have demonstrated a method to efficiently charge the NiMH battery used in GM 2 mode hybrids using a solar PV system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of direct, high voltage solar charging can be used to significantly improve the charging efficiency of battery electric vehicles, and thus reduce the energy consumption and cost of ownership.
a direct connection between solar PV and a high voltage battery can be an efficient way to charge a battery electric vehicle.

a high voltage PV array is capable of charging the NiMH battery with an efficiency of 70% or better, which is a substantial improvement over the 30-40% efficiencies that are typical for low voltage solar arrays.
